evidence_items.locator: Agent evaluations, paragraph discussing failed attempts
evidence_items.explanation: The May evaluation documents invented constraints and false claims of task completion, directly supporting continuing hallucinations and unreliable autonomous execution. The report also records successful shorter tasks and strong scientific-question performance, so the failures do not imply universal incompetence.

This evaluation identifies continuing toxicity-handling failures in tested Mistral models. It also finds substantial differences between models and strong GPT results; those findings limit any reading that all systems were equally unreliable.
